models.name: Consensus Protocol: Gork 27B
models.description: NVFP4 quantization of Gork-27B-Cybersecurity: 24 GB instead of 54 GB; security and general scores are within 2 points of the BF16 model, and BFCL parallel tool calls are 3–4 points higher.
models.author: conpro

models.name: DeepSeek: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Uncensored (DealignAI)
models.description: Uncensored release · Native FP8 (e4m3) + FP4 experts · 40-layer MoE · 1M context · Vision + video · Reasoning tiers · Tools
models.author: deepseek

models.name: MiniMax: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
models.description: MiniMax M3.1 Flash with NVFP4 expert and MXFP8 linear weights supports text, image and video input, reasoning, tool calling and structured JSON output. Each request has a 1,048,576-token context limit with at most 65,536 output tokens. Built with MiniMax M3.1-Flash.
models.author: minimax

models.name: NVIDIA: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
models.description: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super VL (120B total, 12B active parameters) with NVFP4 expert weights supports text, image and video input (one image and one video per request), reasoning, tool calling and structured JSON output. Each request has a 1,048,576-token context limit with at most 65,536 output tokens.
models.author: nvidia

models.name: Xiaomi: MiMo V2.6 Flash RL
models.description: Xiaomi's MiMo V2.6 Flash RL supports text, image, video and audio input, reasoning, tool calling and structured JSON output. Each request has a 1,000,000-token context limit with at most 65,536 output tokens.
models.author: xiaomi

models.name: DeepSeek: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.description: We introduce DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 552B backbone parameters and support for contexts of up to one million tokens. The model natively processes images and text, and generates text autoregressively.
models.author: deepseek

models.name: Z.ai: GLM 5.3 Flash Cybersecurity (DealignAI)
models.description: DealignAI's cybersecurity build of GLM 5.3 Flash, with refusals removed, in W4A16 (int4 experts, BF16 activations). It takes text, image and video input, reasons, calls tools and returns structured JSON. Each request has a 1,048,576-token context limit with at most 65,536 output tokens. Its template knows three reasoning levels: minimal and low run at Low, medium and high at High, xhigh at Max; thinking cannot be switched off. Its safety guardrails are substantially reduced.
models.author: z-ai

models.name: Z.ai: GLM 5.3 Flash
models.description: GLM-5.3-Flash — 195 GB on disk (down from the 643 GB BF16 source) — INT4 W4A16 quantization of the routed experts in compressed-tensors pack-quantized format, for Hopper (H100 / H200) via vLLM Marlin kernels.
models.author: z-ai

models.name: Qwen: Qwen3.8 Flash Next Abliterated (DealignAI)
models.description: DealignAI's abliterated Qwen3.8 Flash Next supports text, images and video, reasoning, tool use, and structured JSON. Requests share model cache capacity with a 1,000,000-token context limit per request and up to 65,536 output tokens.
models.author: qwen

models.name: Tencent: WeMM Embedding 2B
models.description: WeMM-Embedding-2B is a universal multimodal embedding model built on Qwen3.5. It accepts text, images, videos, visual documents, and interleaved multimodal inputs, and returns a 2,048-dimensional L2-normalized embedding. Audio input is not supported.
models.author: tencent

models.name: Ornith: Ornith 1.5 35B A3B
models.description: Chirp Chirp! 🐦 We are introducing Ornith-1.5, a major step toward building foundation models through end-to-end self-improvement.
models.author: ornith-ai

models.name: InternScience: Agents A1 4B Cybersecurity (hotdogs)
models.description: hotdogs' cybersecurity build of InternScience's Agents-A1 4B: his abliterated Fable-Preview fine-tune with a cybersecurity LoRA (Fenrir, Trendyol and Cybersecurity-ShareGPT data) merged at half strength, in INT8 W8A8. Text input, reasoning that can be switched off, tool calling and structured JSON. Each request has a 262,144-token context limit with at most 65,536 output tokens. Its safety guardrails are reduced.
models.author: internscience

models.name: inclusionAI: Ling 3.0 Flash
models.description: inclusionAI's Ling 3.0 Flash with MXFP4 expert and FP8 dense weights supports text input, reasoning, tool calling and structured JSON output. Each request has a 262,144-token context limit with at most 65,536 output tokens.
models.author: inclusionai

models.name: DeepSeek: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 Abliterated (cebeuq)
models.description: A decensored (abliterated) rebuild of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 — a 284B-parameter DeepSeek-V4 MoE agentic-coding / reasoning model — served unquantized at native FP4+FP8 across 2× NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, 128 GB each) with vLLM.
models.author: deepseek

models.name: Google: DiffusionGemma 26B A4B
models.description: A 26B mixture-of-experts diffusion language model from Google. It denoises 256-token blocks in parallel instead of writing one token at a time, so a stream arrives in blocks and a reply under one block arrives in one chunk. Sampling controls such as temperature and seed do not apply to its sampler, and structured output is not available.
models.author: google

models.author: openbmb

models.name: Google: Gemma 4 31B
models.description: Gemma is a family of open models built by Google DeepMind. Gemma 4 models are multimodal, handling text and image input (with audio supported on small models) and generating text output. This release includes open-weights models in both pre-trained and instruction-tuned variants. Gemma 4 features a context window of up to 256K tokens and maintains multilingual support in over 140 languages.
